text:
alex: Kicking off readiness thread for ACME on-prem cluster go-live today. Targets: 4x A10G pools, private VPC peering, air-gapped seed, and new control-plane local mode. Please ack if you own any step.

priya: Ack. I own network validation, certs, and customer ACL verification.

tomas: I'll handle GPU pool provisioning + MIG setup. ETA ~45m.

mei: Quick heads-up on region constraints — customer data center is in NL but they expect eu-west latency. Recommend enabling local-control-plane flag to reduce chatter to central.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued by alex — job_id=deploy-5421 status=queued :gear:

alex: Priya — drop network checklist here pls (we'll need the MTU, BGP peer info, and TLS fingerprints).

priya: Pasting quick checklist snippet: ```- MTU: 1500 (customer had 9000 mismatch before)
- BGP ASN: 64512
- Allowed CIDRs: 10.0.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/16
- TLS fingerprints: sha256:3a:7c:...``` I'll send to customer and request ACL updates.

tomas: Provisioning logs: `nvmlDeviceGetCount=4` GPUs detected. Starting MIG profile application. If MIG fails, fallback to whole-GPU passthrough.

jordan: Cost note: disabling burst autoscale on on-prem increases our reserved capacity footprint ~12% vs hosted; customer PO confirms acceptance. Adding to billing ticket.

mei: Cluster health checks in-progress: kube nodes Ready 4/4, all kube-proxy pods running, kv-cache warming. Observed one node spike during MIG application — recommending cordon+drain then reapply kernel module.

tomas: Cordon/drain done on node-03. Applied runtime patch: `rdw-runtime v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2` — kernel modules reloaded. p95 latency improved ~18%.

priya: Found MTU mismatch on customer side (they had 9000). Coordinated fix with their netops. Large payload tests now succeed (scp and model blobs).

alex: Can infra-bot run the final acceptance script? infra-bot, kick it?

infra-bot: Acceptance-run started by alex. Steps: 1) model pull test, 2) sample inference 1k tokens, 3) KV cache persisted across restart, 4) metrics ingestion to prod collector. status=running

tomas: Model pull OK — sha256:9b7f... Sample infer: p50=210ms p95=410ms for 1k tokens on A10G pool. No OOMs.

mei: Metrics ingestion alerted: spooler targeting staging collector by mistake. Updating endpoint to `prod-collector.internal:9200` and restarting metrics-agent.

priya: Verified control plane heartbeat stable from customer VPN and SFTP connectivity tests passed.

alex: Any remaining blockers before handoff to Customer Success?

jordan: Finance/cost alignment signed off. Ticket FIN-4521 updated.

priya: Customer ops confirmed acceptance on call (attendee: @customer-admin). They verified inference, file transfer, and ACLs.

alex: Great — I'll prepare the handoff notes and post the deploy artifacts.

infra-bot: Acceptance-run finished: SUCCESS. Artifacts: /artifacts/accept-1809012345.tar.gz checksums: sha256:4d2e...

tomas: Note for runbook: if `nvidia-mig` reports a stuck job during profile apply, restart `nvidia-modprobe` and wait 30s, then `systemctl restart rdw-runtime`. Worked here.

mei: Post-live ops: schedule 24h watch with oncall rotation: tomas -> priya -> mei. I'll create the pager rota.

alex: Thanks everyone :tada: We'll hand this off to CS and mark the delivery ticket DONE once docs are uploaded.
